turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and why did Owen find out from his phone?
What would you want me to say to Owen tomorrow?
That's not my job. You still haven't told me who decided.
Like the actual words. Write it out for me and I'll read it to him.
I'm not writing your lines, Hale. Show me what you have on the essay.
